BiblicalUsage: Shamsherai is named once, among the sons of Jeroham of Benjamin, in the genealogy that counts the heads of the tribe. He stands beside Shehariah and Athaliah, and the verse is the whole of his story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the Benjamites by name, even the ones whose story is a single line in a genealogy.
